home.headline: QR experiences that can
home.description: Build a single QR destination that can evolve from a digital contact card to a menu, a heritage guide, or a hosted document—while each organization keeps its own data boundary.
home.dynamicRecords: Dynamic records resolve from a short code
home.contactDescription: vCards, contact details, social links, and shareable business profiles.
home.menuDescription: ETB-priced menus with room for Telebirr checkout metadata.
home.tourismDescription: Multilingual audio, place coordinates, and historical media.
home.documentsDescription: Hosted PDFs and asset metadata behind a changeable short link.
home.footer: FaidATech · Built for tenant-aware QR experiences
home.databaseNote: PostgreSQL schema target · External PostgreSQL connection required
login.title: Sign in to continue.
login.description: Use your Manus account to access the QR dashboard. Each account is connected to its own organization workspace.
login.failed: Sign-in could not be verified. Please try again.
login.securityNote: Authentication is handled through Manus OAuth. FaidATech does not store your Manus password.
qr.showingMatching: Showing {shown} of {total} matching codes. Exports use the current short link.
campaign.qrCodesAndScans: QR codes and scan totals are organization-scoped.
campaign.noAssignmentsDescription: Campaign records are part of your tenant schema. Once a campaign is assigned to a QR code, its linked codes and scans will appear here.
analytics.createPrompt: Create a dynamic QR code to start collecting scan analytics.
integrations.manusDetail: Dashboard access uses a verified Manus OAuth session and organization membership.
integrations.telebirrDetail: Add merchant details and an HTTPS checkout URL to menu QR codes. Payment is completed by the hosted provider.
integrations.contentDetail: Provide stable public HTTPS URLs for visitor-facing audio, historical media, and PDF documents.
integrations.paymentSafetyNote: FaidATech stores checkout metadata and redirects visitors; it does not receive or store payment card credentials.
wizard.purposeDescription: Choose the purpose that best fits the visitor experience.
wizard.choosePurposeError: Choose a QR purpose to continue.
wizard.contentPrompt: Add the content visitors will see
wizard.titlePlaceholder: A clear name for this QR
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description shown to visitors
wizard.reviewDescription: The printed code will keep this short address while you can update the experience later.
wizard.exportsAvailable: SVG & PNG exports are available after saving.
wizard.externalUrlNote: Make sure every external URL uses HTTPS and is hosted at a stable address. Your public short link is created from the configured application origin.
wizard.destinationUpdated: Your destination is updated. The existing printed QR code continues to work.
wizard.shortCodeReady: Your short code is ready. Download the QR image or open the visitor preview.
wizard.headingDescription: Choose what visitors should see, personalize its brand, then review the result before saving.
wizard.purposeLandingSummary: Create a flexible page with a hero, story, and call to action.
wizard.purposeVcardSummary: Share a contact card people can save in one tap.
wizard.purposeMenuSummary: List categories and ETB prices, with optional Telebirr metadata.
wizard.purposeTourismSummary: Make a place speak in multiple languages with audio and GPS.
wizard.purposePdfSummary: Keep a short code in print while the hosted document can change.
wizard.purposePaymentsSummary: Point a printed QR to a hosted checkout URL.
field.contactNote: Build a contact card visitors can save to their phone.
field.menuItemsNote: Items with the same category name appear together in the visitor menu.
field.telebirrMetadataNote: Optional. Adds a checkout button to the public menu when a URL is supplied.
field.additionalMetadataNote: Optional provider metadata stored alongside the checkout link.
field.guideSummaryNote: Add one or more audio links, the location coordinates, transcripts, and heritage media.
field.transcriptNote: Optional text shown under the audio player for each selected language.
field.caption: Caption
field.hostedDocumentNote: The short code redirects visitors to this PDF while its hosted file metadata remains editable.
field.hostedAssetMetadataNote: Optional asset properties retained with this document.
field.localCheckoutNote: Create a direct dynamic short link to a Telebirr or other hosted checkout URL.
field.paymentHandlingNote: FaidATech stores the checkout destination and redirects visitors. It does not collect or process payment details.
field.chooseDestination: Choose a destination type to add its details.
